fot_token_configured.meaning: a fee-on-transfer token is configured as the disputeToken

dispute_created.meaning: a user calls disputeTree() and sends disputeAmount tokens

fee_deducted_on_deposit.meaning: the FoT token deducts a transfer fee so the contract receives less than disputeAmount

tree_updates_blocked.meaning: no new Merkle trees can be published and tree revocation is blocked, freezing claims on stale data

assumptions: The 990/1000 token figures are illustrative examples, not asserted observed values.
The disputer is an honest user acting in good faith, not an attacker.
Whether resolveDispute(true) or resolveDispute(false) is attempted first is unspecified and irrelevant to the blocked-tree outcome.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the disputer is authorized or whether disputeTree is permissionless; the valid-dispute scenario is treated as the applicability scope.

limitations: The blocked-tree impact is formalized as a Boolean observable because the report gives no numeric definition of tree publication or revocation counts.
Only the tree_updates_blocked impact is formalized here; resolve_reverts, disputer_stuck and no_recovery are handled in separate passes.
